notes: The original deterministic source archive and companion SHA-256 file are retained. Publication inventory, privacy checks and all existing source/runtime checks remain required. Reusable HA source is maintained in this repository.
SOURCE_VERSION identifies the portable source collection; independently versioned Helm chart and upstream HA release pins are preserved.

Only a verified frozen SOURCE_VERSION overlay may differ from the committed snapshot. Ordinary local packaging still requires an entirely clean commit. No restore, cluster mutation, deployment or physical acceptance is performed.
